'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***[[Attack on Nabatieh municipal council]]
****At least 16 people, including the mayor are killed in an [[Israeli Air Force|IAF]] [[airstrike]] on a municipal building of [[Nabatieh]], [[southern Lebanon]], with Lebanese [[Prime Minister of Lebanon|Prime Minister]] [[Najib Mikati]] condemning the attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy43z81nnvlo (BBC News)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Foreign involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[North Korea–Ukraine relations]]
***[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] says that [[North Korea]] has now become directly involved in the war in [[Ukraine]], with a senior Ukrainian intelligence official saying that around 3,000 [[Korean People's Army|North Korean troops]] are currently in [[Russia]] and are training for deployment to [[Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine|Russian-occupied territories]]. [https://www.politico.eu/article/russia-war-battalion-north-koreans-fight-against-ukraine-volodymyr-zelenskyy/ (Politico)]
**[[United States and the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] announces a new $425 million [[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|military aid package]] for [[Ukraine]], containing long-range weaponry. [https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-war-latest-35/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]

'''Disasters and accidents''' 
*[[2024 Majiya fuel tanker explosion]]
**At least 180 people are killed and dozens of others are injured when a gasoline tanker overturns and explodes in Majiya, [[Jigawa State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/16/nigeria-fuel-tanker-explosion-kills-dozens (Al Jazeera)]
*Bodies of five [[Russia]]n [[climbing|climbers]] that disappeared on October 6 while summiting [[Dhaulagiri|Mount Dhaulagiri]] in [[Nepal]] are discovered near the peak and retrieved. [https://apnews.com/article/nepal-russian-climbers-bodies-retrieved-d4a57deecb88ee57561d8ee452189047 (AP)]
*An explosion at a house in [[Newcastle upon Tyne]], [[England]], kills at least two people and injures six others. An investigation to determine the cause of the explosion by the [[Health and Safety Executive]] is underway. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c79n083lrdgo (BBC News)]
*Three workers are killed and four others are injured when a [[bridge collapse]]s into the [[Strong River]] ahead of it's demolition in [[Mississippi]], [[United States]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/mississippi-bridge-strong-river-collapse/story?id=114873786 (ABC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[8 January Brasília attacks|2023 Brazilian Congress attack]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Brazil]] determines the government must seek the [[extradition]] of Brazilian nationals accused of participating in the 2023 attack on government buildings in [[Brasília]] who are currently residing in [[Argentina]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazil-orders-extradition-jan-8-rioters-currently-argentina-2024-10-16/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Indian bomb hoaxes]]
**It is reported that at least 10 flights operated by [[India|Indian]] airlines have received [[bomb threat]] hoaxes over the past 48 hours, causing the flights to be delayed or diverted. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c30l4gp6z6mo (BBC News)]
*[[Attorney General of Spain]] [[Álvaro García Ortiz]] is charged by the [[Supreme Court of Spain|Supreme Court]] for revealing secrets about a tax fraud case involving the boyfriend of the president of the [[Community of Madrid]] [[Isabel Díaz Ayuso]]. However, García Ortiz announces that he will not resign. [https://www.rtve.es/noticias/20241016/supremo-abre-causa-contra-fiscal-general-del-estado-por-presunto-delito-revelacion-secretos/16289788.shtml (RTVE)]
